description.text: Introduction: 1. The teaching language of this program is English. 2. 10 or more students will form a class and only group registration is accepted. 3. The students could choose any schedule to organize the courses as well as timetable. Other special requirements will be further considered due to the condition for the detailed requests. 4. The students could attend class hours of Chinese students and communicates with them. Contents: 1. Lectures on Chinese Culture and Literature 2. The study of Kongfu (or Chinese martial arts), traditional culture and art. 3. Visit and Practice 4. Touring and Sightseeing For details of this program, please download this document Short-term study program.doc

duration.text: The Short-term Study Program at Wuhan University of Technology is a 1 Month long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 208 USD/per month ￥ 1500 CNY/per month

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Health Certificate Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: 1.Applicants must be age of 16 or above 2.High school graduate or equivalent or above
